definition: Read-only semantic audit of the #51 same-head swaps. Exact / Near / Wrong compares each swapped FNDDS name with the Nutrition5K cafe ingredient whose food nouns overlap the vision query. Auto labels are suggestions. Every swapped row needs a person.
human_must_confirm: Automatic Exact / Near / Wrong labels are suggestions only. They do not close the audit on the 37/50 code-swapped multi-component dishes. A person has to confirm every review row.

Confirm which cafe ingredient, if any, the vision query was naming. The match uses food-noun overlap with the query. It has no synonym table, so steak against beef, yam against sweet potato, and salmon against fish stay unmatched or Wrong until a person links them.
Confirm Exact: the food nouns match, and the code does not add a preparation, cut, or style the cafe name lacks. Raw, fresh, NFS, NS, and plain are treated as unspecified.

Confirm Near: same food nouns with a different preparation, cut, or style; one name's food nouns contained in the other; or a variety/color difference such as sweet versus plain potato, white versus brown rice, or chinese broccoli. Near is not an identity success. A qualifier can name a different commodity.

Confirm Wrong: the query shares no food noun with any cafe ingredient, the code negates a cafe noun such as no cheese, the code is a meat analog the cafe ingredient is not, or the leftover nouns are not a subset or a variety qualifier.
A smaller calorie error is not evidence that the swapped code is the right food. Rows with energy_improved_but_identity_not_all_exact are the disagreement set and have to be read one by one.
Ambiguous ties, and matches under the existing 8 g / 8 kcal ingredient floor, need a person to pick the referent. Deprecated cafe rows are ignored.
